subsystem: UIKitCore.framework - UIScrollView Paging, Boundary Snapping & Page Target Resolution

horizontal_page_width.description: Page width matches view frame bounds width excluding content insets.

vertical_page_height.description: Page height matches view frame bounds height excluding content insets.

interpage_spacing.description: Optional interpage gutter spacing (default 0.0pt, common in UIPageViewController or carousel layouts).

origin_coordinate.description: Base origin anchor for page grid indexing.

velocity_threshold.description: Minimum release fling speed required to trigger velocity-based directional page advance.

displacement_threshold.description: Displacement threshold used when release velocity is below velocity_threshold (|v| < 200.0 pt/s). If progress past current page exceeds 50%, target advances to next page.

decision_rules.action: Directional page advance based on velocity sign: k_target = (velocity > 0) ? (k_current + 1) : k_current
Displacement cutoff: delta = (contentOffset - s_page(k_current)) / W_effective; k_target = (delta > 0.50) ? (k_current + 1) : k_current

standard_paging_limit.policy_description: UIKitCore UIScrollView isPagingEnabled enforces single-page clamping per drag gesture: delta_k in {-1, 0, +1}. High velocity flicks cannot skip multiple pages.

continuous_detent_skipping.policy_description: Custom snap collections allow multi-detent skipping by evaluating projected landing offset s_proj = s0 + v / (-1000 * ln(d)) and snapping to nearest detent.

ballistic_paging_deceleration.description: Exponential deceleration using d = 0.985 to brake rapid finger momentum as viewport moves toward target page.

spring_settling_transition.trigger_condition: Viewport enters target page boundary capture basin (|s - s_target| < 20.0 pt) or overshoots target page coordinate.
